purpose: Independent evidence audit of requested peak-vs-baseline sentiment shifts; excerpts are sampled discourse, not fact verification.
guardrails: Whole-post polarity is not target-aware sentiment toward the named entity or hashtag.
Top-engagement rows are evidence of what was amplified in the topic extraction, not prevalence-weighted sentiment estimates.
User-generated death, violence, resignation, and event claims in excerpts are reported as text claims/discourse only and were not externally verified.
Quoted, reposted, sarcastic, fandom, sports-banter, and multilingual posts can make target stance indeterminate.
